response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, or grouping each time you open a project, this feature ends that repetition. Create a view once—by status, assignee, priority, due date, or any combination of filters—and it stays ready exactly as you left it. Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep dedicated setups for sprint planning, client reporting, personal triage, or anything else your workflow demands, without cluttering a single list. Views aren't locked to your account either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of reconstructing it individually or emailing screenshots back and forth. Rename, reorder, or delete views anytime as priorities shift, and switching between them takes a single click, whether you're triaging today's tasks or reviewing a quarter's backlog. Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no added cost. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
